_comment: Owner-accepted npm audit advisories (OPS-03, 07.1 D-46). Read by web/scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry is one GHSA id for the packages named, valid through reviewBy. Never add an entry without an owner ruling.

npmAuditExceptions.reason: Moderate. glob 13.0.6 is pulled in only by the lint and license tools (typescript-eslint, license-checker-rseidelsohn) and never ships to the browser. The fix (glob 14.0.2+) is a major version under the 14-day cool-down that the tools do not support yet. Published 2026-10-30.

Moderate. minimatch 10.2.6 is pulled in only by the ESLint stack, the license tool and openapi-gen tooling and never ships to the browser. The fix (minimatch 11.0.1+) is a major version under the 14-day cool-down; ESLint 10.14.0 still requires ^10.2.6. Published 2026-10-30.
